cards.fatal_flaw: Suppliers and franchised distributors may refuse an intermediary that takes neither title nor credit risk; taking title needs $8-27M of working capital (T2), and the allocation value evaporates in a glut.
cards.founder_fit_note: Marginal: the portal and operations fit the founder; supplier credibility needs an industry veteran cofounder.
cards.possible: marginal - depends on suppliers recognizing the co-op
cards.profitable: marginal - good margins if allocation materializes
